summary: Plain offset accessor that returns a pointer 32 bytes past the object base (this + 32). No fields, globals, guards or callees are recorded in the packet; the returned region is consumed by network packet send/accept callers.

local_names.this: object base pointer (char*); the returned value is a view 32 bytes past it

operations.description: Returns a pointer 32 bytes past the object base (this + 32); a straight-line offset getter with no branching, field reads or side effects.

Used by network packet send/accept callers, notably NetworkPacketSendWithQueryMatching and NetworkAccept (as well as sub_57DC10 and sub_57DE30), which consume the returned offset view to reach the data region.

unresolved: What the region 32 bytes past the object base holds is not determinable from this packet; only that the network packet send/accept callers consume it.
